title: Live-tail + point-in-time snapshot exports for audit console
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Background: Customers and internal SOC teams need both an interactive live-tail view of audit events (for incident response) and the ability to create immutable point-in-time snapshot exports for compliance and forensic analysis. Current console export flows are limited to ad-hoc CSV/JSON exports of the current query and do not capture a consistent snapshot when events are being ingested rapidly, nor do they honor RBAC v2 scoping and SSO/SAML attribute mapping consistently for export permissions.

Scope: Implement a live-tail mode in the audit console UI with throttled streaming + gap detection, and add a snapshot export feature that: (1) pins the query at a server-side cursor/time boundary, (2) exports to NDJSON or CSV with optional compression, (3) enforces RBAC v2 export permissions and cross-tenant masking, and (4) surfaces a saved "snapshot query" that can be re-run or scheduled. Also add pagination cursors for large snapshot downloads and an export job queue with retention-aware warnings.

Out of scope: historical retention policy changes, backend storage migration, multi-tenant cross-account joins (future work).
acceptance_criteria: Live-tail UI shows new events in near real-time with a configurable max-rate (default 100 events/s) and visual gap indicator if events >5s delayed
Snapshot export creates a server-side consistent cursor and returns an export job ID; download link provides NDJSON or CSV compressed file compatible with downstream SIEMs
Export obeys RBAC v2: only principals with 'audit.export' or admin role can export full PII; others receive masked fields per RBAC policy
Snapshot export pagination uses cursor-based tokens for resumed downloads; client can request next page with token until completion
Saved snapshot queries persist query, filters, time-range, and export schema; only visible to users with export/view permissions per RBAC
SAML/SSO attribute-based roles are reconciled during export authorization: mapped roles are checked against RBAC v2 policies
Export job appears in user export history with status (pending, running, complete, failed) and retention metadata
Automated tests cover RBAC checks, snapshot consistency under concurrent writes, pagination tokens, and common export formats
tasks: Backend: extend audit search API to support snapshot cursors and export job submission
Backend: implement paginated NDJSON/CSV streaming endpoint with resume tokens
Backend: integrate RBAC v2 checks into export path and field-level masking
Backend: add export job queue, throttling, and retention warnings
Frontend: add live-tail UI with rate control, pause/resume, and gap markers
Frontend: add 'Create snapshot export' flow with format, compression and saved-query option
Frontend: export history view with download links and job state
E2E: tests for snapshot repeatability during high-ingest
Docs: update audit console export and RBAC docs, include SAML mapping notes
notes: Design consulted with SOC and compliance: requirement for immutable snapshot for legal holds and post-incident analysis
We need to avoid exporting full unmasked PII for non-admins; follow RBAC v2 field-level masking design from ENG-33421
Consider NDJSON as default because downstream tooling (Splunk, Elastic, Sumo) ingests JSON lines easily; provide CSV for simple analyst workflows
Snapshot should record server-side 'snapshot_id' and ingest watermark (last_processed_offset) so replays are deterministic
Export file size expectations: customers with high-volume (100k+ events) should prefer queued jobs and S3-style signed URLs for download
SAML/SO mapping: confirm group->role sync frequency. If mapping lag exists, export authorization must use currently effective mapping with warning in export history
RBAC v2: admins can opt to allow 'export without masking' via org policy; must log that consent in export metadata
open_questions: What is the default retention/TTL for generated export download links? (30 days proposed)
Should we provide a 'dry-run' that returns a stats summary (count, example rows) before queuing a full export?
How do we handle very large exports (>50GB)? Stream to customer-provided S3 vs internal staging?
If a saved snapshot query is scheduled, what scheduling UI & permissions are needed?
Audit event schema evolves; what export schema versioning do we include in snapshot metadata?
risk_mitigation: Throttle live-tail and limit default rate to avoid DoS from many open tails
Require explicit export consent for unmasked data and record consent event in audit logs
Quota exports by org and provide admins visibility into queue length
Fail-safe: if RBAC check or SAML mapping fails, block export and surface actionable error with contact for support
comments: 2026-03-11 - Daniel Cho: Initial spike complete. Backend API sketch in RFC doc. Key decision: use cursor-based snapshot (snapshot_id + offset) rather than time-based windows to guarantee determinism.
2026-03-12 - Priya Nair (PM): Confirmed compliance ask to persist snapshot metadata for 1 year. Marked as dependency for legal review.
2026-03-13 - Security Review: Preliminary review flagged need to ensure SAML group sync delays do not allow unauthorized exports. Proposed mitigation added to notes.

2026-03-14 - QA: Found edge case where resume token expires after 24h; QA suggests making token TTL configurable per org

Run export with RBAC-masked and unmasked permutations and verify fields are masked correctly
Simulate SAML group mapping delay and verify export is denied with clear error
Resume paginated download using resume token and validate deterministic records
